entities.summary: Hedda Sterne was a Romanian-born American artist who was an active member of the New York School of painters. Her work is often associated with Abstract Expressionism and Surrealism. She was also the only woman to appear in the famous photograph of abstract expressionist artists dubbed "The Irascibles", although the group included other women. Hedda Sterne was a authors & novelists from Bucharest (1910-08-04, Bucharest–2011-04-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
